name_en: Aish el saraya, served cream-topped syrup dessert

portions.basis: Assumed weighed 150 g shop-style served square; not a measured restaurant mean.

origin_note: calculated from an adaptation of Samara Alkhammach, The Matbakh, Aish El Saraya https://thematbakh.com/aish-el-saraya/: six crust-trimmed bread slices modelled as 150 g edible white bread (assumed 25 g each), 1.5 US cups milk (366 g), 3/4 US cup cream (178.5 g; USDA 238 g/cup), 2 tbsp each cornstarch (16 g) and flour (15.625 g; USDA 125 g/cup), 1 US cup sugar (200 g), 1 US cup water (236.5882365 g), 1 tsp lemon juice (assumed 5 g), 1/4 cup pistachios (30.75 g; USDA 123 g/cup). Two tbsp floral waters modelled as 30 g water, optional extra floral water omitted. All syrup retained, no discarded milk solids. Standardize cooled finished mass to the ingredient sum by restoring evaporated water; this yield is a calculation convention, not a measured cooking yield. The source permits less syrup; this profile specifically includes all of it. Ingredient nutrient profiles are the existing foods-file USDA entries: bread-toast-white USDA FDC 325871: https://fdc.nal.usda.gov/food-details/325871/nutrients; milk-full-fat USDA FDC 322892: https://fdc.nal.usda.gov/food-details/322892/nutrients; cream-heavy USDA FDC 2346386: https://fdc.nal.usda.gov/food-details/2346386/nutrients; corn-starch-dry USDA FDC 169698: https://fdc.nal.usda.gov/food-details/169698/nutrients; flour-white-dry USDA FDC 790018: https://fdc.nal.usda.gov/food-details/790018/nutrients; sugar-white USDA FDC 169655: https://fdc.nal.usda.gov/food-details/169655/nutrients; lemon-juice USDA FDC 167747: https://fdc.nal.usda.gov/food-details/167747/nutrients; pistachios USDA FDC 2515379: https://fdc.nal.usda.gov/food-details/2515379/nutrients; Micronutrients left null; cooking retention not modelled.
